newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern appeals to Conrail holders.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern appeals to Conrail holders.

text.p: The chairman of Norfolk Southern Corp appealed to Conrail Inc shareholders, saying he hoped and believed they would defeat a measure critical to a proposed merger between Conrail and CSX Corp .

"I hope and believe when all the votes are counted the result will show that Conrail shareholders have rejected the opt-out proposal. This will set the stage for the Conrail board of directors to discuss implementation of the $115 (per share) all-cash Norfolk Southern offer -- somewthing we've sought from the beginning," he said.
Conrail chairman David LeVan gave Goode the opportunity to speak at the special meeting of shareholders.
Goode also said that the three companies must prepare for rail transportation in the next century.
"We are willing to sit down with Conrail and CSX to make that happen," he said.
Conrail has repeatedly rejected the $10.3 billion bid from Norfolk Southern, saying that CSX's $9.3 billion offer provides more benefits.
"Norfolk Southern is a fine company and we have worked well together in the past," LeVan said, but added that Conrail believes the CSX transaction provides more benefits.
